title: Retractable hooks and garment rod wall mount hook, 2.5-inch hanging space, solid brass Carolina Allied Brass
description:
Create convenient hanging space in a compact footprint with this retractable hooks and garment rod wall mount hook. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2 inch of hanging space, then pushes back in so it stays out of the way.

Highlights:
- Retractable wall hook / pull-out garment rod for coats, robes, and towels
- Space-saving wall mount design (ideal for classic bath accessories and entry or closet organization)
- Supports up to 15 lb
- Solid brass construction with traditional styling from the Carolina collection for matching Carolina coordinated sets
- Customize the look: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob
- Mounting hardware included; fits standard interior walls

Specs:
- Overall: 3.75 inch W x 1.75 inch H x 1.75 inch L; projection 1 inch
- Installation: drill a 3/4 inch diameter hole through drywall and 3 small holes around; 6/32 toggles
- Product weight: 1 lb
- Finish selection: available in 28 designer finishes, including statement options like lavender, autumn sparkle, fire engine red, golden yellow, and spanish gold

A refined choice for traditional bathroom hardware and heritage bathroom fixtures where you want function without visual clutter.

_previous.title: Carolina Retractable Wall Hook
_previous.description: Avondale Decor's retractable wall hook is a unique and space-saving solution for hanging coats, robes, towels, or any other items you need to keep within reach. The hook installs quickly and easily without the need for additional support on or built into the wall — just drill a hole and use the included toggle bolts to fasten it in place. The rod pulls out to provide 2-1/2" of hanging space, then can be pushed back in so it's out of the way when not in use. Choose from 17 stylish finishes and four different models to match your decor.
